method: Independent second reader manually read every one of entries[334:500], all five original fields, the full authenticated canonical record and every variant. Every English canonical shard was authenticated against its manifest SHA256; identical physical duplicate records were collapsed, and every samefold differently cased neighbour was examined (none for these 166). Selected uncertain facts were checked against primary institutional, lexical, scientific or technical sources; unresolved specialist terms were not approved. Mere index, glossary, heading, label, string-finding or unnamed archive placeholders were rejected as examples. A correct sentence for an unrecorded sense, POS or unestablished replacement spelling was not credited as coverage of this head.
scope: Only these 166 exact original row digests and current canonical hashes; no approval of unread rows, generated replacement proposals, other senses, all 500 pack entries, or the whole dictionary.
